## Parental OpControl 0.17.15

- Websites → Visited sites now uses the family time zone for "today", the date picker, the day boundaries and every time shown. A visit at 6:48 PM local on the 26th now belongs to the 26th. Screen time uses the same family-day boundaries.
- Changing the day no longer lets an older request overwrite the newer list.
- Visited sites has a Refresh button and quietly refreshes every 30 seconds while open, keeping the scroll position and filters.
- Each visited domain shows an "n subdomains" toggle. It expands to the subdomains visited that day (`search.brave.com`, `talk.brave.com`, …) with their own counts and Review / Block / Allow buttons. Blocking a subdomain blocks only that host and its own subdomains; the main row keeps the totals. Computers now report the full host as well as the main domain.
- Devices has a new "Notify me when this device goes offline" setting. It is off by default for Windows and Linux computers and on for phones. Existing computers are set to off; the online/offline status and last seen still show on the dashboard.
- Tamper alerts (service stopped, DNS settings changed, uninstall attempts) are unchanged and still sent even when offline notifications are off.
- This release is offered to all devices through the normal catalog.
